scope: Server & gameplay update: machine A server lane plus machine B server-side Tower work. Verified in-game captures only; no client-only work.

evidence_levels: 6 = in-game run in the headless client against the Rust server, with server records and saved-state/relogin checks; 4 = automated tests plus build/launch checks; 3 = engine tests only
